event.title: Palisades Fire
event.lede: On 7 January 2025 a wildfire began in the hills above Pacific Palisades and, driven by strong winds, burned towards Malibu.
facts: Began at about 10:30 a.m. local time on 7 January 2025 (CAL FIRE).

maturity.text: No NISAR analysis for this event. The images are Copernicus Sentinel-2 and Landsat-9 made here; the perimeter is NIFC's and the heat detections are NASA FIRMS'.

finding.text: CAL FIRE's incident record gives 23,448 acres (about 94.9 km²) burned. The official perimeter drawn here measures the same, and VIIRS satellites detected heat inside it on 7–12 January 2025.
